company.name: Collectly
company.shortDescription: Collectly helps healthcare organizations increase collections, automate billing operations, and elevate the patient financial experience.
company.description: Collectly is an innovative tool for practices that want to demystify the medical billing process and boost patient collection rates. Collectly helps healthcare organizations collect patient payments, automate, and streamline internal revenue cycle operations, and elevate the patient financial experience. It also helps hospitals and health systems boost self-pay and after-insurance-responsibility engagement.

productsAndServices.description: A healthcare revenue cycle management platform that automates patient financial workflows from pre-visit eligibility and estimates through billing, payments, and account resolution.
productsAndServices.name: Collectly AI Revenue Cycle Platform

productsAndServices.description: Automates patient billing after care through digital and paper statements, reminders, omnichannel outreach, payment options, and AI-supported billing assistance.
productsAndServices.name: Post-Visit Billing Automation

productsAndServices.description: Provides payment infrastructure for patient financial workflows, including card-on-file storage, autopay, payment plans, recurring payments, refunds, adjustments, and digital wallets.
productsAndServices.name: Payments Platform

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered patient billing agent that provides 24/7 voice and chat support for billing questions, payment options, insurance details, and balance resolution.
productsAndServices.name: Billie AI Voice

productsAndServices.description: Automates insurance eligibility verification and benefits interpretation, including coverage checks, copay determination, additional coverage discovery, and payer portal data retrieval.
productsAndServices.name: AI Eligibility & Benefits

productsAndServices.description: Estimates a patient’s expected financial responsibility before care using coverage, allowed amounts, coordination of benefits, and applicable Good Faith Estimate requirements.
productsAndServices.name: AI Cost Estimation
